question: According to the PRS report of the Ministry of Agriculture, which two crops contributed to 78% of the country's food grain production till 2015-16?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wheat and Rice**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the PRS report of the **Ministry of Agriculture, wheat and rice contributed to 78% of India's food grain production up to 2015-16**. 
 
• The **production of wheat and rice increased after the Green Revolution in the 1960s.**
 
• The Green Revolution **began in 1965 when High Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds** were first introduced in Indian agriculture.
 
• **Wheat production increased the most during this time. **
 
• India is the **second largest producer of rice in the world, after China.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The agriculture sector employs nearly half of the workforce in the country.
 
• It contributes to 17.5% of the GDP (at current prices in 2015-16). 
 
• The agriculture sector’s contribution has decreased from more than 50% of GDP in the 1950s to 15.4% in 2015-16 at constant prices.
 
• India’s production of food grains has been increasing every year.
 
• India is among the top producers of several crops such as pulses, sugarcane, and cotton.
 
• It is the highest producer of milk and the second highest producer of fruits and vegetables.
